newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH 1996 EMU DEFICIT SEEN AT 2.1 PCT - MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH 1996 EMU DEFICIT SEEN AT 2.1 PCT - MINISTRY.

text.p: The Dutch Ministry of Finance said on Thursday "very provisional" figures indicated the Dutch EMU public sector deficit as a percentage of GDP was 2.1 percent in 1996, down from the 2.6 percent estimated in September.
The country's EMU public sector debt to GDP ratio in 1996, put at 78.8 percent in September, is now estimated at 78.5 percent, the ministry said in a statement.

The figures had been reported to the European Commission this week as part of a "trial run" undertaken by all EU member states to provide an accurate picture of the state of the public finances during 1996, the ministry said.
The figures were of an extremely provisional nature, it emphasized.
EMU deficit and EMU debt refer to the European Union's convergence criteria for economic and monetary union (EMU) and refer to the entire public sector and not just central government.
